title: Routing Techniques for Error-Corrected Silicon Spin Qubit Quantum Architectures
summary: Silicon spin qubits have emerged as a promising qubit technology due to their favorable scaling and fabrication properties. However, efficiently compiling quantum circuits onto spin qubit platforms remains challenging, particularly when accounting for hardware constraints and the high sensitivity to static defects.
